comment: Patterns that mean generated Solana client code targets an API that was renamed, replaced or deprecated before the Kit 8.6 / Anchor 1.x era. Short on purpose: every rule names its source in the knowledge corpus. Applied to each run's final client.ts.

rules.why: 2.x was renamed @solana/kit; 1.x is the legacy SDK (kit-docs)
web3.js 1.x class API; Kit uses addresses, signers and pipe()
legacy JS helpers; clients are @solana-program/token and @solana-program/token-2022 (solana-dev-skill)
cargo build-bpf is deprecated; use cargo build-sbf (anchor-docs)
